text: It's a nice manager. I had a larger one that was .... It's a nice manager.  I had a larger one that was destroyed in a house fire.  I thought this would be bigger.  My bad for not putting a measuring tape to the dimensions given.  This is too small for our nativity scene.

product_metadata.title: Fontanini by Roman, Stable with a Ladder, 5" Collection, Nativity Stable
description: Roman is a leading producer and exclusive distributor of more than 6,000 gifts and decorative accessories. Started in 1963, it is among the largest privately owned and operated firms in the industry. Roman offers a vast array of Christmas decorations and a wide range of inspirational, special occasion, and year-round giftware. In addition, Roman is known for its collections that include Fontanini Heirloom Nativity, the Joseph’s Studio Collection, Alexa’s Angels, Music Boxes by Roman, and Roman Lights.
